title: Fitness center operating hours
content: The Building Alpha fitness center is open Monday through Friday from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and weekends from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Access requires an active tenant badge.
source: Building Alpha Tenant Handbook · Amenities · revised August 2026

title: Loading dock deliveries
content: Loading dock deliveries require a reservation between 7:00 AM and 5:00 PM on weekdays.
source: Building Alpha Operations Manual · Deliveries · revised August 2026

title: Conference room comfort policy
content: Occupied conference rooms may be adjusted between 68°F and 75°F. Changes outside that range require facilities approval.
source: Building Alpha Energy and Comfort Policy · section 4.2
